task.name: pick_marker_transfer_place_plate_ep1
task.description: Use the left arm to grasp the marker, transfer it to the right arm and then use the right arm to put it in the green plate.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the marker.
2. Grasp the marker with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to a transfer position.
4. Move the right arm to approach and align with the marker held by the left arm.
5. Grasp the marker with the right arm.
6. Release the marker from the left arm.
7. Move the right arm to align with the green plate.
8. Release the gripper to place the marker into the green plate.
